description: This file defines classes and functions for parsing OTA payload files, including reading payload.bin from OTA.zip, handling metadata, and resolving operation types. It includes classes like Payload, OTAPayloadBlobWriter, OpType, and MergeOpType, and uses external libraries such as zip.js and protobufjs.

classes.name: StopIteration
classes.description: Custom error class used to signal stopping iteration during payload reading.

classes.name: OTAPayloadBlobWriter
classes.description: A specialized zip.Writer for reading payload.bin in OTA updates, capable of stopping early after header reading.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Main class for parsing OTA.zip files, extracting payload.bin, and reading metadata and manifest.

classes.name: DefaultMap
classes.description: Extension of Map with a getWithDefault method that returns the key if not present.

classes.name: OpType
classes.description: Class that creates a map to resolve operation types from protobuf encoding.

classes.name: MergeOpType
classes.description: Class that creates a map to resolve COW merge operation types from protobuf encoding.

methods.name: writeUint8Array
methods.description: Writes a Uint8Array to the zip payload and updates the blob, stopping after reading header info.

methods.name: unzip
methods.description: Extracts payload.bin and metadata from the OTA.zip file.

methods.name: readInt
methods.description: Reads an integer of specified size from the binary buffer.

methods.name: readHeader
methods.description: Reads and parses the header of payload.bin, including magic, version, and signature lengths.

methods.name: readManifest
methods.description: Reads and decodes the manifest from payload.bin.

methods.name: readSignature
methods.description: Reads and decodes the signature from payload.bin.

methods.name: parseMetadata
methods.description: Extracts specific metadata fields from the raw metadata string.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Payload object by unzipping and parsing metadata.

methods.name: getWithDefault
methods.description: Returns the value for a key or the key itself if not present.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the class with protobuf types for operation resolution.
